integrity: The claim is proved analytically from the graph structure; no finite experiment is used as an infinite proof. The n=2 maximum-clique exception is handled explicitly.
limitations: The theorem is restricted to the line-graph family L(K_{1,1,n}) with n>=2. Targeted literature and semantic searches do not constitute an exhaustive proof against uncatalogued or unpublished equivalents.
title: Mobile general position of \(L(K_{1,1,n})\)
